applyTo: "**/*RELEASE*,**/*DEPLOYMENT*"

# Release & Git Conventions
- Exclude `node_modules/` and `.env` from all commits.
- Include Summary, Changes Made, Test Evidence, Known Limitations, and Reviewer Checklist in every PR.
